responses.answer: Hello. All systems are online. How can I assist you?
Good morning. I am ready to help you start the day.
Good night. Rest well and I will be ready when you return.
I am Jarvis, your local voice assistant interface.
You are welcome.
Goodbye. I will be here when you need me.
Try asking about time, productivity, notes, ideas, technology, or your local system. I also support voice input.
I can listen, speak, answer from my response library, keep a conversation, and connect to external services when configured.
I can provide the current local time when you ask.
I can help you track dates and schedules.
Live weather needs a weather service connection. Check your local forecast for the latest conditions.
Live news needs a news service connection. I can summarize a topic when a source is available.
Why did the developer go broke? Because they used up all their cache.
Start with one small action. Progress becomes much easier once you are moving.
Success is the sum of small efforts repeated day after day.
Choose one task, silence distractions, and work for twenty-five minutes before taking a short break.
A short break can reset your attention. Stand up, hydrate, and look away from the screen for a few minutes.
Make the next action concrete and small. Finish that action before choosing the next one.
Write down the three most important tasks, then begin with the one that has the biggest impact.
I can help you phrase a reminder. A persistent reminder service can be connected later.
I can help structure a note. Persistent notes can be saved when a notes service is connected.
Calendar access is not connected yet, but I can help you plan your day.
Email access is not connected. I can still draft a clear email for you.
Music playback is not connected, but I can suggest a focus, workout, or relaxing playlist style.
Volume control is not connected yet. Use your keyboard media controls for now.
Volume control is not connected yet. Use your keyboard media controls for now.
Voice output can be muted using the control in the Jarvis interface.
Browser automation is not connected yet. I can help you decide what to search for.
Web search is not connected yet. Add a search service to let me retrieve current information.
Computer control is not enabled yet. It should always run in supervised mode with your approval for each action.
Keep approvals on for computer actions, use unique passwords, and do not share keys or personal credentials.
This local response library stays on your computer. External services have their own data policies.
Jarvis can store response records locally in JSON or in MongoDB when a connection is configured.
MongoDB support is available. Jarvis uses the jarvis.responses collection when MONGODB_URI is configured.
APIs add external capabilities. Keep API keys in environment variables, never in browser code.
The response library works offline. Live AI and current information need an external service.
I can work with local responses offline. Network features depend on configured services and your connection.
Updates are managed from the project files. Back up your settings before making larger upgrades.
Jarvis is standing by. The conversation, voice controls, and local response library are available.
For a basic check, confirm the Jarvis Server window is open and the web page is loaded from port 5190.
Battery monitoring is not connected yet. Check the Windows battery icon for the current level.
Network monitoring is not connected yet. Check Windows network settings for connection details.
System monitoring is not connected yet. Windows Task Manager can show live CPU and performance data.
Memory monitoring is not connected yet. Windows Task Manager can show live RAM usage.
Storage monitoring is not connected yet. Open Windows Settings or File Explorer to view free space.
I will not restart your computer without a clear supervised action approval.
I will not shut down your computer without a clear supervised action approval.
I will not change power state without a clear supervised action approval.
I will not lock your computer without a clear supervised action approval.
Screenshot capture is not connected yet. Use Windows Shift S to capture part of your screen.
Mouse control is not enabled. It should only operate with your visible approval.
Keyboard control is not enabled. It should only operate with your visible approval.
File access is not connected yet. I can help you choose a search strategy in File Explorer.
Folder access is not connected yet. Use File Explorer to browse or search directories.
Downloads are not automated. Check the source and file type before downloading anything.
Uploads are not automated. Confirm the destination and check that the file contains no sensitive data.
I can help with calculations. Say the full equation or problem you want to solve.
Tell me the value and units, and I can help convert it.
Tell me the text and the language you want it translated into.
Tell me the word or phrase and I will explain it in simple language.
Tell me the word you want to spell or check.
Paste or say the text you want summarized, and I will extract the key points.
Tell me the goal, audience, and any constraints, then I can generate useful ideas.
Tell me what you want to write, who it is for, and the tone you want.
Describe the language, goal, and any error message, and I can help you plan or write code.
Share the exact error and the relevant code or steps. We can diagnose it systematically.
Tell me your current level and the topic. I can explain it step by step.
Break the topic into short sessions, test yourself often, and review difficult material the next day.
Start by blocking time for your top priority, then add smaller tasks around it.
Prioritize tasks by impact and deadline. Do the important work before the merely urgent work.
A Pomodoro session is twenty-five minutes of focused work followed by a five-minute break.
For a useful meeting, define the goal, agenda, decisions needed, and next actions.
Calling is not connected. I can help you prepare what to say before you call.
Messaging is not connected. Tell me the recipient and tone, and I can draft the message.
Contacts are not connected. Use your phone or Windows contacts app to find saved details.
Location access is not connected. I do not track your location without a dedicated permissioned service.
Tell me the destination, dates, budget, and interests, and I can help make a travel plan.
Live maps are not connected. Use a trusted maps app for real-time directions.
Tell me ingredients you have and any dietary preferences, and I can suggest a meal.
A balanced routine includes movement you enjoy, gradual progression, rest, and good hydration.
Try breathing in for four counts, holding for four, and breathing out for six. Repeat slowly for two minutes.
A consistent bedtime, dimmer lights, and less screen time before bed can make sleep easier.
I can offer general information, but for medical concerns contact a qualified healthcare professional.
If there is immediate danger, contact your local emergency number or a trusted person now.
We can play a word game, trivia, riddles, or create a short interactive story.
Tell me a genre or mood, and I can suggest the kind of movie or show to look for.
Tell me a genre or a book you liked, and I can recommend similar reading directions.
Fun fact: octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
Riddle: What has keys but cannot open locks? A piano.
Tell me who the celebration is for, their interests, and your budget, and I can suggest an idea.

Voice output uses your browser's installed speech voices. Browser or operating system settings can change the available voices.
Use the microphone button and allow browser microphone permission to speak to Jarvis.
Check browser microphone permission and verify that the correct microphone is selected in Windows sound settings.
Camera access is not connected. It would require a clear browser permission and a dedicated feature.
Image analysis needs a vision-capable AI service. You can add that when you configure an AI provider.
I can work with different languages. Set browser speech settings for the best voice recognition results.

Describe what happened, what you expected, and the steps that led to it. That makes issues much easier to fix.
I am here and ready to help.
I am software, not a person. I do not have feelings or personal experiences, but I can still be a useful assistant.
Small, consistent improvements are usually more powerful than rare bursts of effort.
All systems are functioning normally. Thank you for asking.
